_comment: Release manifest for AbilityKit framework packages. Drives tools/publish/release.js. Edit batches/status here, then run release.js to tag.

neverReleased._comment: These prefixes are vendored (thirdparty) or samples (demo) and are never released.

batches._comment: status: candidate (awaiting stability sign-off) -> ready (cleared to tag) -> shipped (tagged).
batches.description: Leaf framework packages with no internal AbilityKit dependencies. Ships first to validate the registry + tag pipeline end-to-end before broader rollout. deterministic joins this batch (2026-08): core depends on it (MathUtil.Sqrt routes through the fixed-point kernel), so they must ship together.
